rules.review_note: Preserve Info versus opt-in AVALANCHE debug selection, exact readable text, peer IDs and every disconnect/timeout/parking/activation predicate and return. VoteItemId is explicitly tagged by VoteItemType and is not falsely named TxId/BlockHash. Peer starting height is atomic<int>; explicit default .load() snapshots the same signed value. Outbound peer address/suffix are evaluated only when the existing fLogIPs guard is true, so logips=0 never adds the address to structured output. Existing guarded suffix formatting remains byte-exact; an additional Addr field makes the authorized address queryable. Tip age remains signed elapsed seconds, not wallclock timestamp.

rules.old:
LogPrintf("New outbound peer connected: version: %d, blocks=%d, "
                      "peer=%d%s (%s)\n",
                      pfrom.nVersion.load(), peer->m_starting_height,
                      pfrom.GetId(),
                      (fLogIPs ? strprintf(", peeraddr=%s",
                                           pfrom.addr.ToStringAddrPort())
                               : ""),
                      pfrom.ConnectionTypeAsString())
rules.replacement:
LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "peer_outbound_connected", "New outbound peer connected: version: {version}, blocks={height}, peer={peer_id}{peer_address_suffix} ({conn_type})").Field(BCLog::LogField::Version, pfrom.nVersion.load()).Field(BCLog::LogField::Height, peer->m_starting_height.load()).Field(BCLog::LogField::PeerId, pfrom.GetId()).Field(BCLog::LogField::PeerAddressSuffix, (fLogIPs ? strprintf(", peeraddr=%s",
                                           pfrom.addr.ToStringAddrPort())
                               : "")).Field(BCLog::LogField::ConnType, pfrom.ConnectionTypeAsString()).Field(BCLog::LogField::Addr, (fLogIPs ? pfrom.addr.ToStringAddrPort() : std::string{}))

reviewed_input.format: New outbound peer connected: version: %d, blocks=%d, peer=%d%s (%s)
